# Seattle Spark Trio

> Live acoustic classical string music for weddings and events in Seattle and the surrounding area, performed by three real humans (and a Spark of inspiration).

Seattle Spark Trio is a classical string trio based in Seattle, Washington. We play live, acoustic, and unamplified for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, receptions, private parties, corporate events, and other special occasions.

## Pricing

- Up to 1 hour: $450
- Up to 1½ hours: $650
- Up to 2 hours: $825
- Up to 3 hours: $1,275

A $250 non-refundable deposit reserves the date and is applied to the total. The balance is due 7 days before the event.

## Booking

- Email: bookthelook@seattlesparktrio.com
- Website: https://seattlesparktrio.com

Please include the event date, venue or city, performance length, and whether the event is indoors or outdoors.

## Good to know

- All music is performed live by professional human musicians. No recordings, no backing tracks, no amplification.
- Outdoor performances need a covered, shaded spot for the instruments.
- Special song requests can be arranged with advance notice.
